name: Atonement The Day Of
overview: The Day of Atonement, observed on the tenth day of the seventh month, is a solemn occasion marked by specific offerings and rituals to make atonement for the high priest, the holy place, and the entire congregation. Aaron, the high priest, offers a bullock as a sin offering for himself and his household, then casts lots on two goats—one for the Lord to be sacrificed as a sin offering, and the other, the scapegoat, to be sent alive into the wilderness, symbolically bearing the sins of the people. This day is observed as a sabbath and involves a profound act of purification and reconciliation for Israel.
